gloss: Cool Biz; summer light-dress energy-saving campaign

definitions.gloss: Cool Biz; summer light-dress energy-saving campaign
definitions.explanation: A Japanese government-led campaign encouraging light summer clothing (no jacket or tie) so that office air conditioning can be set higher to save energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧クールビズ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: In summer we work in Cool Biz style.

examples.japanese: クールビズな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ネクタイ→ネクタイ：01040_nekutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなくて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's Cool Biz, so you don't have to wear a tie.

examples.japanese: クールビズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{冷房|れいぼう}→冷房：01755_reibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}め→高め：14861_takame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the Cool Biz period, the air conditioning is set to a higher temperature.

notes:
Promoted by the Japanese government from 2005 to cut summer cooling energy. Workers dress lightly (no jacket or necktie) so offices can keep air conditioning around 28°C.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クールビズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to carry out Cool Biz
- クールビズ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: the Cool Biz period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ウォームビズ→ウォームビズ：29537_woomubizu⟧: Warm Biz — the winter version, encouraging warm dress so heating can be reduced
